scope: All closeout002-c5* roots, including matching regular files, plus closeout-002/candidate-c5; excludes this publication directory from original inventory.
redaction_policy: Replace only exact fixture credentials and quoted credential-record values (including encrypted_secret) with [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL], including repeats in keys. Preserve every other byte, all outcomes, exit statuses, timings and historical receipts. Original logs remain private, unchanged and excluded from staging.
scan_policy: Read credential fields including access_key/secret_key/access_key_id/encrypted_secret, Authorization/proxy-Authorization, Cookie/Set-Cookie, SigV4 Authorization and presigned credential/signature/token values; extract private retained restore fixture access_key/secret_key values without logging them; exact-search all candidates and intended publication payloads. Decompress gzip incrementally. Raw samples.jsonl omitted only because each has a scanned existing gzip archive.
limitations: This is a bounded privacy review of the exact hashed inventory, not certification of future files or all possible personal data.
Raw failed receipts retain their original results. Sanitized copies are derivative publication evidence, never replacements for original-hash provenance.
No files were staged, committed or pushed; the coordinator must use explicit publication paths and exclude originals.
